$refresh_cadence: 案例增量:每 6 个月;结构性大调整:每 12 个月

$tiktok_specific_fields.video_length_seconds: 视频时长(TikTok 关键分层维度)
$tiktok_specific_fields.sound_type: trending | original | licensed | none —— TikTok 独有维度
$tiktok_specific_fields.hook_pattern: 对应 playbook §5 的 6 种 hook 之一(broken-hook | number-promise | before-after | pov | suspense | hot-take)
$tiktok_specific_fields.loop_designed: boolean —— 视频结尾是否为 rewatch 设计
$tiktok_specific_fields.fyp_penetration: high | medium | low —— 是否成功进入 FYP unconnected reach

$notes.trend_decoupled_from_case_studies: 案例样本关注结构模式(hook / length / loop);具体 trending sound / hashtag 每 2-4 周从 Creative Center 单独刷新(tiktok_trend_snapshot.json)
